deadline.value: The deadline for admission and Oxford scholarship consideration is 2026-12-02.
deadline.quote: 12:00 midday UK time on Wednesday 2 December 2026

entry_route.value: Applicants should hold or be predicted to achieve a first-class or strong upper second-class undergraduate degree with honours; a previous master's qualification is not required.
entry_route.quote: a first-class or strong upper second-class undergraduate degree with honours in engineering or a related discipline relevant for the proposed area of research, such as physics, materials science, computer science, applied mathematics or chemistry. a previous master's qualification is not required.

supervisor.value: The department recommends contacting potential supervisors ahead of submitting an application.
supervisor.quote: We recommend contacting a potential supervisor(s) ahead of submitting your application.

funding.value: All eligible applicants who apply by the deadline are automatically considered for Oxford scholarships.
funding.quote: final application deadline to be considered for oxford scholarships

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: DPhil in Engineering Science (Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering) at the University of Oxford.
